title: A vector type
description:
Make 2D vectors behave like numbers. `Vec(x, y)` makes a vector: a table `{ x = x, y = y }` with a shared metatable `VecMeta` that gives it these operations:

| Expression | Result |
|---|---|
| `a + b`, `a - b` | a new vector, added or subtracted part by part |
| `a * 3`, `3 * a` | a new vector, both parts multiplied by the number |
| `a * b` (two vectors) | the dot product, `a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y`, a number |
| `-a` | a new vector pointing the other way |
| `a == b` | true when both parts are equal |
| `#a` | the length, `math.sqrt(x^2 + y^2)` |
| `tostring(a)` | `"(3, 4)"` |

Every vector made by `Vec` (and every vector the operations return) must have `VecMeta` as its metatable.

solution.solution.lua:
VecMeta = {}

function Vec(x, y)
    return setmetatable({ x = x, y = y }, VecMeta)
end

VecMeta.__add = function(a, b) return Vec(a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y) end
VecMeta.__sub = function(a, b) return Vec(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y) end
VecMeta.__mul = function(a, b)
    if type(a) == "number" then return Vec(a * b.x, a * b.y) end
    if type(b) == "number" then return Vec(a.x * b, a.y * b) end
    return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y
end
VecMeta.__unm = function(a) return Vec(-a.x, -a.y) end
VecMeta.__eq = function(a, b) return a.x == b.x and a.y == b.y end
VecMeta.__len = function(a) return math.sqrt(a.x * a.x + a.y * a.y) end
VecMeta.__tostring = function(a) return "(" .. a.x .. ", " .. a.y .. ")" end

hints: `setmetatable(t, VecMeta)` returns `t`, so `return setmetatable({ x = x, y = y }, VecMeta)` is the whole constructor.
`__mul` is called for `a * 3` and for `3 * a`: check which argument is the number with `type`.
unitTests:
test("adding and subtracting", function()
    local a, b = Vec(3, 4), Vec(1, 2)
    local sum = a + b
    check_eq(sum.x, 4)
    check_eq(sum.y, 6)
    check(getmetatable(sum) == VecMeta, "a + b must be a vector too")
    local diff = a - b
    check_eq({ diff.x, diff.y }, { 2, 2 })
    check_eq(a.x, 3, "a + b must not change a")
end)

test("scaling and the dot product", function()
    local a = Vec(1, 2)
    local s1, s2 = a * 3, 3 * a
    check_eq({ s1.x, s1.y, s2.x, s2.y }, { 3, 6, 3, 6 })
    check_eq(Vec(3, 4) * Vec(1, 2), 11)
    check(getmetatable(s2) == VecMeta, "3 * a must be a vector")
end)

test("negation, equality and length", function()
    local n = -Vec(3, -4)
    check_eq({ n.x, n.y }, { -3, 4 })
    check(Vec(1, 2) == Vec(1, 2), "equal vectors")
    check(Vec(1, 2) ~= Vec(2, 1), "different vectors")
    check_eq(#Vec(3, 4), 5.0)
    check_eq(#Vec(0, 0), 0.0)
end)

test("printing", function()
    check_eq(tostring(Vec(3, 4)), "(3, 4)")
    check_eq(tostring(Vec(1, 2) + Vec(0.5, 0)), "(1.5, 2)")
    check_output(function() print(Vec(-1, 0)) end, "(-1, 0)")
end)
